about.intro: I'm a *Full Stack & AI Developer* focused on building **intelligent, scalable, and user-centric applications**.
about.description: I'm passionate about building software that solves real-world problems through modern web technologies, artificial intelligence, and robotics. I enjoy transforming ideas into practical products while continuously learning new technologies and improving my skills. Whether it's developing full-stack web applications, AI-powered platforms, or robotics systems, I strive to create **clean**, **efficient**, and **impactful** solutions.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Devang Kumar**, a B.Tech student specializing in **Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning** at Hi-Tech Institute of Engineering & Technology, affiliated with AKTU.

My journey into software development began with curiosity and quickly grew into a passion for solving real-world problems through technology. Over the years, I've explored web development, backend engineering, artificial intelligence, robotics, databases, and modern software architecture by building projects, participating in hackathons, and constantly learning new technologies.

My primary stack includes *React*, *Next.js*, *Node.js*, *Express.js*, *JavaScript*, *TypeScript*, *Python*, *Java*, *MongoDB*, *MySQL*, and *Tailwind CSS*. Alongside web development, I've also worked extensively with *ROS 2*, *Gazebo*, *RViz*, *URDF*, *Xacro*, Linux, and robotics backend development, gaining practical experience in robotic software systems and simulations.

Some of my most meaningful projects include **Street Dog Health Twin (SDHT)**, an AI-powered platform designed to improve stray dog healthcare, **MoodMate**, an AI-assisted mental wellness application, and a **Cybersecurity Awareness Platform** focused on educating users through modern web technologies. These experiences have strengthened my abilities in software architecture, backend development, teamwork, and product design.

Beyond development, I actively participate in hackathons, enjoy experimenting with emerging technologies, and constantly challenge myself to build better software. My long-term goal is to become a professional **Software Engineer combining Full Stack Development and Artificial Intelligence**, creating intelligent systems that make a meaningful impact.

projects.title: Street Dog Health Twin (SDHT)
projects.description: Street Dog Health Twin (SDHT) is an AI-powered platform designed to improve the healthcare and welfare of stray dogs through digital health monitoring. The system creates digital profiles for stray dogs, enables volunteers and NGOs to report health conditions, and is designed to integrate RFID collars for intelligent tracking. Developed as an ideathon-winning project, SDHT combines artificial intelligence, full-stack development, and social impact to support animal welfare initiatives.

projects.title: MoodMate
projects.description: MoodMate is an AI-assisted mental wellness platform that enables users to track their mood, maintain personal journals, and receive AI-generated insights. The application encourages healthier daily habits through intelligent recommendations while providing a modern, responsive, and user-friendly experience.

projects.title: Cybersecurity Awareness Platform
projects.description: A modern cybersecurity awareness platform developed to educate users about cyber threats, phishing attacks, password security, and safe online practices. Built using modern frontend technologies with responsive design and interactive user experiences, the project focuses on spreading cybersecurity awareness through engaging content and intuitive design.

roadmap.description: Started my B.Tech journey in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning while learning programming fundamentals, object-oriented programming, and data structures. During this period, I built a strong foundation in software development and problem-solving.

Expanded into modern web development by learning HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, backend development, and database management. Built multiple academic and personal projects while strengthening frontend and backend development skills.

Worked as a Robotics Backend Engineer Intern at NextUp Robotics while also participating in hackathons and developing AI-powered full-stack applications. During this period, I gained practical experience with robotics software development, Linux, ROS 2, and backend system integration.

Built impactful AI projects including Street Dog Health Twin (SDHT) and MoodMate, won college ideathons, developed modern full-stack applications with Next.js, and continued improving software architecture, backend engineering, and AI integration skills.

My goal is to become a Software Engineer combining Full Stack Development and Artificial Intelligence, building scalable systems, intelligent applications, and impactful technology while continuously learning and contributing to innovative products.
